`84-84`: **🗄️ Data Integrity & Integration** | **🟠 Major** | **⚡ Quick win** ⚠️ **Unverified finding** Verification ran but could not confirm this finding. It is shown for review, not as a verified issue. **Make float formatting independent of `serialize_precision`.** If a worker sets `serialize_precision=17`, `var_export(0.1, true)` produces `0.10000000000000001`. A SQLite DECIMAL read into a string property then receives those extra digits instead of `0.1`. Use a shortest-round-trip conversion that does not depend on the worker’s INI setting, and test that setting. PHP’s exporter reads `serialize_precision` directly. ([github.com](https://github.com/php/php-src/blob/master/ext/standard/var.c)) As per path instructions, “Every finding must name the concrete input or scenario that fails.” _Source: Path instructions_
